name: Affiliate Commerce
description: Attributes Drupal Commerce orders to affiliates and creates commission conversions (per order or per order item) when an order completes.
project_description: Affiliate Commerce is the Drupal Commerce integration submodule of Affiliated. It adds affiliate_account and affiliate_campaign base fields to commerce_order, stamps the current buyer's cookied affiliate onto their order via an order processor during cart recalculation, and — when the order transitions to complete — creates affiliate_conversion entities (one per order, or one per order item) for each conversion type configured for Commerce. Commissions are computed from the conversion type's default commission as either a flat amount or a percentage of the order/order-item total. Actions are recorded as commerce_log entries. Part of the affiliated project (version dir 1.0.x, 1.0.0-alpha).
